dialogues.speaker: Nayla
dialogues.text: Yes, I still am. I'm an Eremite born and raised, and I grew up listening to legends of King Deshret. My beliefs will not be easily swayed.

dialogues.speaker: Nayla
dialogues.text: But I no longer believe in his revival.

dialogues.speaker: Nayla
dialogues.text: Huh, from the looks of it, I'd wager you're the new friend the boss talked about.

dialogues.speaker: Nayla
dialogues.text: The Eremites always welcome new hands, but I'll remind you that even friends are not forever.

dialogues.speaker: Nayla
dialogues.text: I, at least, will make you no guarantees that we'll always be on the same side.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The revival of King Deshret is a lie.
